appName.message: Data Saver — Block Ads, Images & Video
appName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and the browser. Chrome Web Store search is per-locale, so each translation should contain the words a speaker of that language would actually type when looking for a tool that reduces mobile data usage.

appDesc.message: Cut your data usage by blocking ads, images and autoplay video. Built for slow, capped or metered connections.
appDesc.description: Short description shown under the name in the store listing. Max 132 characters.

cmdToggleSite.message: Stop or resume blocking on the current site
cmdToggleSite.description: Description of the keyboard shortcut, shown on chrome://extensions/shortcuts

popupTagline.description: Subtitle under the extension name at the top of the popup

savingsCounting.description: Placeholder in the savings meter before the popup has read its stored totals

savingsEmpty.message: Browse a little and your savings will show up here
savingsEmpty.description: Shown in the savings meter when nothing has been blocked yet

savingsEstimated.description: Footnote making clear the byte figure is an estimate, not a measurement

savingsEstimatedSince.description: Footnote with the date counting started

savingsAds.description: Label under the count of blocked ads

savingsImages.description: Label under the count of blocked images

savingsVideos.description: Label under the count of blocked videos

savingsReset.description: Button that clears the savings totals

siteNoHost.description: Shown instead of a hostname on browser pages like the new tab

siteNothingToDo.description: Status line when there is no site to act on

siteBlocking.description: Status line when the current site is being blocked normally

siteNotBlocking.description: Status line when the user has excluded the current site

siteDontBlock.description: The main button. Says what pressing it DOES, not what the current state is.

siteResume.description: The main button when the site is already excluded

shortcutHint.description: Precedes the keyboard shortcut keys under the main button

saved.description: Brief confirmation after a toggle is changed

savingsRequests.description: Unit beside the big blocked-request count. The count is EXACT; the byte figure below it is an estimate, which is why the count leads.

savingsBytes.description: Byte estimate shown under the request count. Always prefixed with an approximation sign.

popupTitle.description: Short product name for the popup header and the toolbar tooltip. appName is deliberately keyword-heavy for store search and is too long here — it wrapped to two lines in Hindi.
